alternative_single_partition.verdict: not recommended: one-tap/reach rule needs >= 6-8 internal taps anyway, glue near the cap, a single 82-macro 13.5 mm2 assembly far beyond any closed block (max 517k / 0.40 mm2); same latency

recommendation: 4 stacked partitions, front in c, R1-R4 (+R2-alt); die plan moves SM-stack ft lanes off the inner SM faces (M8/M9) or R5 verified, before G3
